quest.title: Timaeus' Alchemy Tutorial
quest.description: Timaeus is deeply enraptured with alchemy. He wonders it there are others like him, that are drawn to this ancient and mysterious art...
quest.rewards_formatted: Insulation Potion x2, Frostshield Potion x2, Heatshield Potion x2

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: I want to find out more about alchemy.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: The ancient art of alchemy is simply captivating... I wish more people appreciated it.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Oh, you're into alchemy too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Very much so.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: #Well then, {M#boy}{F#girl}, it's time for you to get some first-hand experience!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: All great accomplishments start with a firm grasp of the basics and go from there.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Let's have you start by making some Shocking Essential Oil.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: It is a foundational alchemical product. The best place for beginners to start.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: To make Shocking Essential Oil, you will need some electro crystal and a frog.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Both can be easily found outside the city— What? You can't see a connection between crystal and essential oil?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Hahaha, that's because there is none! The electro crystal is for the shocking part; it's the frog that provides the essential oil.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Once you've gathered everything, try and create some Shocking Essential Oil. No half measures now, give it all you've got! I'll be watching from here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Let's have you start by making some Frosting Essential Oil.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: It is a foundational alchemical product. The best place for beginners to start.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: To make Frosting Essential Oil, you will need a lizard tail and some mist flower corolla.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Both of these are found frequently in the wild— The point of the lizard tail, you ask?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Why, the crispness of a frozen lizard tail makes for a far more appetizing potion!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Hahaha. That was a joke.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Once you've gathered everything, try and create some Frosting Essential Oil. No half measures now, give it all you've got! I'll be watching from here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Let's have you start by making some Flaming Essential Oil.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: It is a foundational alchemical product. The best place for beginners to start.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: To make Flaming Essential Oil, you will need a frog and a flaming flower stamen.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: You should easily be able to find these outside the city— You want to know why we mix a frog with fire?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Why, flaming flowers have to be diluted with the mucus found on frogs' skin before they are safe for consumption...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: I mean... Ah, no! I didn't say anything. I said nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Once you've gathered everything, try and create some Flaming Essential Oil. No half measures now, give it all you've got! I'll be watching from here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Understood.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: So then, let's start with something simple.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But what about bold innovation?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: (Test) I like your style. I'm excited to see what we will come up with. Now, go and get me the materials I need!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Remind me about that potion?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Have you finished making the Shocking Essential Oil?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Still working on it...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Shocking Essential Oil is made from electro crystal and frog.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: It shouldn't be too hard to find them when you're out and about. Gathering raw materials is a major part of the alchemist's work, you'll just have to get used to it.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: When you've found them, try making some Shocking Essential Oil and show me how it turns out.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Remind me about that potion?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Have you finished making the Frosting Essential Oil?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Still working on it...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Frosting Essential Oil is made from lizard tail and mist flower corolla.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: It shouldn't be too hard to find them when you're out and about. Gathering raw materials is a major part of the alchemist's work, you'll just have to get used to it.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: When you've found them, try making some Frosting Essential Oil and show me how it turns out.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Remind me about that potion?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Have you finished making the Flaming Essential Oil?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Still working on it...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Flaming Essential Oil is made from frog and flaming flower stamen.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: It shouldn't be too hard to find them when you're out and about. Gathering raw materials is a major part of the alchemist's work, you'll just have to get used to it.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: When you've found them, try making some Flaming Essential Oil and show me how it turns out.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Yes, it's ready.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Nice work! This is some genuine bona fide Shocking Essential Oil alright. It helps people channel Electro energy more easily.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Now, let me tell you what happens if you swap the frog for butterfly wings!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: It produces a powerful Insulation Potion, which protects the taker against electroshocking.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Amazing, isn't it? The very same electro crystal can, depending on the specific alchemical process used, produce two completely opposite effects.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Go on, take this Insulation Potion and get a taste of what alchemy can really do!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Yes, it's ready.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Wow, that's a mighty fine batch of Frosting Essential Oil you've made! Rub some of this on you to get more in touch with your Cryo side...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: But guess what happens if you swap out the lizard tail and use crystal core instead?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Boom! You got yourself a Frostshield Potion, which protects you against the harmful effects of too much playing in the snow, amongst other things!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Amazing, isn't it? The very same mist flower corolla can, depending on the specific alchemical process used, produce two completely opposite effects.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Here's a Frostshield Potion for you. Now, go and get a taste of what alchemy can really do!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Yes, it's ready.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: That sure smells like Flaming Essential Oil alright! And you can really feel the heat too.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Did you know that there is a similar recipe using butterfly wings instead of a frog?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Voilà! You have yourself a Heatshield Potion. If you're ever rescuing a baby from a burning building, this little thing will make sure you don't even break a sweat.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Amazing, isn't it? The very same flaming flower stamen can, depending on the specific alchemical process used, produce two completely opposite effects.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Take this Heatshield Potion and get a taste of what alchemy can really do!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: (Test) I've got all the ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: (Test) Excellent! Now, let's add a few of these, a touch of this, mix it all up... and I have no idea what will happen.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: (Test) Aha, it's finished! Take it, see if you can find out what it does. I have no idea — but that's the exciting thing about alchemy!
